_readme: All ad copy lives here. Wrap the lime accent word(s) in *asterisks*. Lengths: micro = 160x600, compact = 300x250 / 336x280 / 1200x628, full = 300x600 / 1080x1080.

A.name: The Number
A.note: Lead concept. The ad states its own targeting. One crowd, one of them is you.

micro.headline: This ad is for about *400* people.

compact.headline: This ad is for about *400* people.

full.headline: This ad is for about *400* people.
full.sub: Marketing leaders in Minnesota. You're one.

B.name: We did our job
B.note: Safest. Targeting as proof. Precision work, the team checking the result.

compact.headline: If you're seeing this, we *did our job.*

full.headline: If you're seeing this, we *did our job.*
full.sub: Precise targeting, measured all the way to revenue. This ad is the demo.

C.name: We found you
C.note: Warmest. We picked you. The personal summons arriving at the mailbox.

compact.headline: We *found you.*
compact.sub: If we can find you, we can find your buyers.

full.headline: We found the *400* marketing leaders worth reaching.
full.sub: Imagine what we'd do with your audience.

D.name: No waste
D.note: Fallback. Least provocative. The orbit diagram with one star at the centre.

compact.headline: No *wasted* impressions.
compact.sub: Not on you. Not on your customers.

full.headline: No *wasted* impressions.
full.sub: Not on you, and not on your customers.
